prompt: I've got a few slash commands and a code-review agent in my project's .claude/ folder that I want to share with my team. Turn them into a Claude Code plugin I can host on our GitHub org. Show me the exact directory layout, the plugin.json, and how my teammates would install it.
assertions: commands/ and agents/ directories are at the plugin root, NOT inside .claude-plugin/
A marketplace.json (or a github plugin source) is provided so the plugin can be hosted on GitHub
Install instructions use /plugin marketplace add <owner/repo> and /plugin install <name>@<marketplace>, and note that plugin skills/commands are namespaced
